cues: Here is the one line test that decides most slides.
Xylem and phloem on the same radius, with cambium between them, means stem.
Then count the xylem groups to decide dicot or monocot.
text: Here is the one line test that decides most slides. Xylem and phloem on the same radius, with cambium between them, means stem. On alternate radii means root. Decide that first. Then count the xylem groups to decide dicot or monocot.
